{{Short description|none}}
'''[[Complex analysis]]''', traditionally known as the '''theory of functions of a complex variable''', is the branch of [[mathematics]] that investigates [[Function (mathematics)|functions]] of [[complex numbers]]. It is useful in many branches of mathematics, including [[number theory]] and [[applied mathematics]]; as well as in [[physics]], including [[hydrodynamics]], [[thermodynamics]], and [[electrical engineering]].

See also: [[glossary of real and complex analysis]].
